scope: Presentation performance phases 0-2: scene presenter, single scene pass, batching, culling, authored DTX mips, GPU skinning, frame-buffer uploads and measurement mode; no renderer or gameplay code imported

references.purpose: Later-generation corroboration that a PolyGrid is submitted as one indexed list and translucent grids are queued/sorted as objects.
Later-generation corroboration of CPU-built world-space particle quads submitted in batches.
Later-generation frustum render-block selection, consulted for the culling direction only.
Later-generation hardware bone-set skinning corroborating GPU node transforms; Blood II ABC uses one node per vertex plus CPU-sampled packed deformation, so no bone sets are imported.

SDL.reason: SDL_SetupPropertyQuery checked its output argument instead of the lookup result; Metal debug devices pass an uninitialized sampler property ID during blit setup. Upstream main checked 2026-10-18 still has both defects.

adaptations: Opaque world triangles grouped by material state per DAT model; translucent faces remain one batch per polygon.
One scene render pass with shared depth and eagerly created shared pipelines; view models use a reserved near viewport depth slice instead of a depth clear.
Conservative bounding-sphere frustum culling of bounded ranges; sky and view-model draws are never culled.
Sprites/particles pre-transformed to world space and merged per consecutive texture/opacity after sorting.
Authored DTX mip levels decoded with the shared palette/masks and sampled with point mip selection.
GPU skinning: static per-asset corner streams, per-frame node palettes and packed deformation in storage buffers, hidden faces collapsed in the vertex shader.
Renderer uploads recorded as copy passes in the frame command buffer.

shader_tools.note: Existing SPIR-V/MSL unchanged apart from the glslang version comment.
